item.content:encoded: I've played Ocarina of Time twice myself (N64 and 3DS), and I've always felt it has a kind of magic to it. item.title: Hot take: I like classical videogame biomes
item.author: invalid@example.com (xyla)
item.dc:creator: xyla
item.content:encoded: I got thinking about Mario Sunshine and how it's a real step to the side from the usual snow, desert, grass, lava biomes/worlds that are usually part of Mario games. I kinda love the classics though and miss them when they're not around. Of course they are not needed in every single game but I love being immersed in a good snow world. That's all, maybe not that hot of a take after all.
